item.title: Entra ID: Dynamic MemberOf Filter will get removed
item.author: Andreas Dieckmann
item.description:
Microsoft is removing the “MemberOf” Filter feature in Entra ID. Interestingly the feature was 4 years in preview. Apparently there were some problems with the feature, so Microsoft decided against proceeding with this one. So “preview” doesn’t mean that there is a guarantee that the feature will ever go “General Available”.

Here is a copy of the Message Center posts:

  • https://mc.merill.net/message/MC1448379
  • https://mc.merill.net/message/MC1488834

It was possible to use this filter for Dynamic Security Groups or for Administrative Units. I also made a video about this topic, you can find it here on YouTube.
